properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 22 at 11:40AM PST until November 27 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal flooding
expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 4 AM PST Tuesday.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 4 AM Tuesday to 1 PM PST
Friday. Most susceptible time of flooding will be around the
time of the morning high tide, with peak tides trending from 7
AM on Monday to 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peak Tuesday through Wednesday,
reaching 7.9-8.3 feet, likely re-breaking the all-time tidal
records set back in late October. Background surf on top of the
tides will remain around 3-5 feet through Wednesday, but an
incoming swell Wednesday into Thursday will bring a sharp
increase to the surf by Thursday morning's high tide. Breaking
waves may reach 6-8 feet with sets up to 10 feet on west-facing
beaches. Surf then moderates some into Friday, but still looks
to be around 5-8 feet.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through flooded areas.
